notes.title: Boards & Barricades Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] ADDED ABILITY TO BARRICADE WINDOWS. Players can find the boards in the supply room.
[*] Modified first night audio to include barricade instructions
[*] Updated How-to-Play
[*] RNG Overhaul with all nightly threats.
[*] Fixed a spawn bug for some zombies spawning too close to a window.
[*] Added SFX for when zombies crawl through windows.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to Roamer mechanics & balance
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Only side room light required to be off now to hide from Roamer.
[*] Flashlight will now cause roamer to "see" you.
[*] Added screen shake to shooting.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor lighting tweak & bugfix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a crawling zombie would get stuck repeatedly climbing through a window.
[*] Minor optimizations regarding volumetric lighting.
[/list]

notes.title: Small update to balance & bugfixes, Official Game Guide added.
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Official game guide added at: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1986285279]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1986285279[/url]
[*] Removed zombie "chase" mechanic in which the zombie would chase the player if the player was within 5 meters so player can now more easily kite a zombie if they need to.
[*] Allowed player to shoot through the boarded windows in the hallway.
[*] Updated balancing throughout the nights for a more fair game.
[/list]

notes.title: Fever Cabin Is Now Available!
notes.content:
We're so excited to announce that the full version of Fever Cabin is now available!

Fever Cabin is a claustrophobic first person horror game. Survive the next five days with your trusty pistol and flashlight while you're waiting for a survival party to arrive. 

Pay attention and listen for audio cues that things are amiss and make sure the shamblers stay out of the cabin!

Available now at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226210/Fever_Cabin/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226210/Fever_Cabin/[/url]
